text:
emily: quick heads-up — found a couple of broken anchors and a confusing cooldown snippet in Dedicated provisioning (autoscale section). opening a tiny cleanup PR.
nate: which snippet?
emily: the YAML example shows `cooldown: 30` with no units. our JS/TS SDK v2 expects milliseconds. i'll update examples and add a migration note.
docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8120  labels: docs, provisioning, ci
frank: please normalize wording to "isolation decorator" across the provisioning + SLA pages so readers don't conflate it with network isolation.
emily: good call — will replace "tenant isolation" mentions and update TOC anchors to `#isolation-decorator`. adding a smokeable YAML snippet in the PR body: 

``
scalePolicy:
  type: autoscale
  minReplicas: 1
  maxReplicas: 10
  cooldownMs: 30000  # v2 SDKs expect ms; older examples used seconds
  targetUtilization: 0.65
isolation:
  decorator: tenant-prefer
```

zoe: add a small CI check in the PR description so broken anchors fail fast: `yarn gen:docs && grep -n "isolation-decorator" site/_build || exit 1`.
emily: added the test step and fixed two TOC links (#isolation-decorator, #eviction-behavior). also left a migration callout for older SDK versions that accepted seconds. pinged @frank and @nate for review.
nate: i'll review SLA-overlap wording. merge after reviews + green CI. if anything slips we can revert the TOC edits.
